steps.en: Install it, and optionally run the demo card to see what your terminal can show
steps.zh: 装上它，可以先跑一下演示卡看看你的终端能显示什么
steps.code: python -m pip install rich · python -m rich

steps.en: Create one Console object and share it across the program
steps.zh: 建一个 Console 对象，全程序共用

steps.en: Detects the terminal's size, encoding, color support and whether output is a terminal at all
steps.zh: 探测终端的尺寸、编码、颜色能力，以及输出到底是不是终端

steps.en: Print text with inline style markup, or pass a ready-made object such as a Table
steps.zh: 打印带样式标记的文字，或直接交给它一个现成对象，比如表格

steps.en: Wraps and lays it out to the width, converts colors the terminal lacks, and writes the escape codes
steps.zh: 按宽度换行排版，把终端不支持的颜色换成近似色，再输出转义码

value.en: Readable colored output, tables and progress bars without hand-writing escape codes or measuring the terminal yourself
value.zh: 彩色输出、表格、进度条都能直接用，不用手写转义码，也不用自己量终端宽度

sources: https://github.com/Textualize/rich#using-the-console (console = Console(); console.print("Hello", "World!", style="bold red"); word-wraps to terminal width; markup)
https://rich.readthedocs.io/en/latest/console.html (auto-detects size, encoding, is_terminal, color_system and converts colors if necessary; TERM=dumb, NO_COLOR, FORCE_COLOR, TTY_COMPATIBLE)
